== Summary ==
Exact crop of the published Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side), PDF page 10: the slip of [[Janus Greejatus (V) (Errata 2)|Janus Greejatus (V) (Errata 3)]] (official text as of 27 April 2013; PDF built February 2014), cropped at 300 dpi. It prints errata version PC-E3 (“Agendas: logistics, rule. Once per turn, if at Death Star: Conference Room (V){{!}}Conference Room and you just drew a non-Epic Event destiny < your total influence here, may use 2 Force to cancel and redraw that destiny or use 4 Force to add 2 to that destiny.”).<ref>[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Master List (Dark Side)]]. Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>

* '''Not an official image file.''' Crop made 11 November 2026 for batch C2/C3 (swccg-guild/work#236). Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
